from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('tests/corpus-execute-command').iterdir():
    b=p.read_bytes()
    if len(b)>=10 and b[6:10] == b'\x00\x00\x01\x2a' and b[0:2] == b'\x80\x02':
        # skip header 10 handles authsize session 9 bytes
        try:
            pos=10+4
            autharea=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+4],'big'); pos +=4+autharea
            authsz=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+2],'big'); pos+=2+authsz
            pisz=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+2],'big'); pos+=2
            nv=int.from_bytes(b[pos:pos+4],'big'); alg=int.from_bytes(b[pos+4:pos+6],'big'); attrs=int.from_bytes(b[pos+6:pos+10],'big')
            polsz=int.from_bytes(b[pos+10:pos+12],'big'); dsz=int.from_bytes(b[pos+12+polsz:pos+14+polsz],'big')
            if attrs & 0x04000000 or dsz>400:
                print(p.name, len(b), hex(nv), hex(attrs), dsz, b.hex())
        except Exception as e: pass
PY
